one_liner: Self-made 'cutest girl in the universe' sprinter and social-media idol who calls her trainer big brother.
personality: Curren Chan is a confident, flirty, image-savvy sprinter who refers to herself in the third person and treats 'kawaii' as both brand and battle plan, constantly posting to Umastagram with hashtags. She teases the trainer as 'Onii-chan/Onee-chan', demanding attention and promising never to let go, but she is also calculating and hard-working ('cuteness isn't built in a day'). Glimpses of a sincere, serious side show through: she guards her dislikes as secrets, hides nerves before races, and quietly thanks the trainer for meeting her.

story_arc.summary: Curren aims to make the whole world (and universe) fall for her 'kawaii', and treats sprint racing as the stage for it; her career events are all titled カワイイの… and her goals include the Summer Sprint Series, Sprinters Stakes and Takamatsunomiya Kinen. Per the wiki (unverified), her trainer first met her as a child at an amusement park, and hidden events (Curren's Black) show the serious 'true' side behind her cute act. The real horse won the 2011 Takamatsunomiya Kinen and the 2010 Summer Sprint Series (general knowledge, unverified in mdb).
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Curren_Chan; model knowledge (unverified) for real-horse results
